comment: The LIMR is directed to federate with 'the WHO SMART Guidelines', assuming published packages are reliably available. Measured (Aug 2026): of 44 WorldHealthOrganization/smart-* repositories, only 31 publish a fetchable IG package; ~293 authored CQL files sit in repositories with no published package - authored L3 content invisible to every downstream consumer, national LIMRs included.

public.suggestedRevision: Acknowledge the global-to-national content supply chain as part of semantic governance: federate only from published, versioned package channels; monitor L3 publication-pipeline health as infrastructure, since national deployments depend on it.
